activity.notes: Johan Maurits arrived at Recife on 23 January 1637 as the Dutch West India Company's governor-general of Dutch Brazil/New Holland. Brazil's National Archive records his departure from Recife on 11 May 1644. ATLAS models the effective governorship in Brazil, not the earlier 1636 appointment date.

sources.title: Johan Maurits — Mauritshuis
sources.citation_text: The Mauritshuis identifies Johan Maurits as governor-general of the Dutch West India Company colony in Brazil and places his Brazilian governorship in 1636-1644.

sources.title: Johann Moritz von Nassau-Siegen, Maurício de Nassau — Arquivo Nacional
sources.citation_text: Brazil's National Archive records that Johan Maurits departed Recife on 11 May 1644 after governing Dutch Brazil.

sources.title: Dutch Brazil: contemporary arrival record
sources.citation_text: A contemporary Dutch source records Johan Maurits arriving in Pernambuco on 23 January 1637.
